summary: Verified v5 World 1 rebuild + glass Vista windows + Resume/Contact apps + Rocky-in-World1 chat + space act auto-enter/exit-guard. All 7 acceptance flows pass on 1440x900 desktop. Backend /api/rocky returns real contact email (source='llm').

issues: Aero translucent border is very subtle over the light wallpaper; night mode reads clearly as glass, day mode barely differentiates the outer glass ring from the white client card. Not a blocker – requirement is met (glass frame + inset client card visible) but the effect is weak in daylight.

critical_code_review_comments: SpaceTransition auto-enter trigger fires around scrollY≈4200 (~77% of 5419 total) rather than exactly 96.5% quoted in the spec; UX still lands correctly because the sticky scene is already at act-end by then, but if the spec wants literal 0.965 threshold, verify the ratio calculation in SpaceTransition.tsx.

day-mode aero glass border on windows has low contrast against light wallpaper — consider bumping the outer border alpha / adding a subtle dark inner shadow so the frame reads as 'glass' regardless of wallpaper brightness.
test_credentials: N/A — password field accepts any value; username prefilled 'Himesh Soni'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When opening the Contact desktop icon after having opened another window, the pre-existing window can intercept the dblclick because its focus overlay sits above the icon. In tests either close the previous window first or open Contact directly via the Computer explorer item [data-testid=explorer-item-contact]. Space-act scrolling requires window.scrollTo (not scrollBy) in 300px increments with ~100ms waits; body has 'hidden auto' overflow so wheel-scroll works but page.mouse.wheel is unreliable. Auto-enter to World2 happens near scrollY≈4200 of ~5419.

detailed_verifications.create_account_toast_no_login: toast text: 'It's a guest session — just press the arrow.'
